title: Ātmavidyāvilāsa
subtitle: The Play of Self-Knowledge

source.edition: Sivayogadipika of Sadasivayogisvara with Atmavidyavilasa (Anandashram); text readings collated against the June 1893 Theosophist printing
source.digitalText: The Sanskrit includes the opening invocation, all 65 numbered verses, and the closing verse. English translation and word-level gloss prepared for this reader.
source.license: Underlying Sanskrit work and 1893 print witness are public domain; English translation and lexical gloss are original for this reader.
source.attribution: Sadāśivendra Sarasvatī, Ātmavidyāvilāsa; Anandashram edition; The Theosophist, vol. XIV, no. 9 (June 1893).
source.changes: Sanskrit punctuation normalized into reader lineation; Devanāgarī transliteration supplied; English translation and gloss newly prepared. This text has no traditional chapter divisions in the cited edition, so its contents navigation now uses three descriptive ranges for the teacher’s grace, the renunciant’s life, and Self-knowledge.

translationCredit: Original English translation and word-for-word gloss prepared for this reader.

units.label: Opening invocation
units.deva:
चिन्मुद्रितकरकमलं चिन्तितभक्तेष्टदं विमलम ।
गुरुवरमाद्यं कञ्चन निरवधिकानन्दनिर्भरं वन्दे ॥
units.iast:
cinmudritakarakamalaṃ cintitabhakteṣṭadaṃ vimalam |
guruvaramādyaṃ kañcana niravadhikānandanirbharaṃ vande ||
units.translation: I bow to the spotless, primordial revered teacher, whose lotus hand bears the seal of awareness, who grants devotees their cherished wishes, and who is filled with limitless bliss.

gloss.en: whose lotus hand bears the seal of awareness

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
वटतरुनिकटनिवासं पटुतरविज्ञानमुद्रितकराब्जम ।
कञ्चन देशिकमाद्यं कैवल्यानन्दकन्दलं वन्दे ॥1॥
units.iast:
vaṭatarunikaṭanivāsaṃ paṭutaravijñānamudritakarābjam |
kañcana deśikamādyaṃ kaivalyānandakandalaṃ vande ||1||
units.translation: I bow to a certain primordial teacher who dwells beside the banyan tree, whose lotus hand is sealed in keen knowledge, and who is the very sprout of liberation's bliss.

gloss.en: whose lotus hand is sealed in keen knowledge

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
निरवधिसंसृतिनीरधिनिपतितजनतारणस्फुरन्नौकाम ।
परमतभेदनघुटिकां परमशिवेन्द्रार्यपादुकां नौमि ॥2॥
units.iast:
niravadhisaṃsṛtinīradhinipatitajanatāraṇasphurannaukām |
paramatabhedanaghuṭikāṃ paramaśivendrāryapādukāṃ naumi ||2||
units.translation: I salute the noble sandals of Paramasivendra: the shining boat that rescues people fallen into the boundless ocean of transmigration, and the small pickaxe that cuts through rival doctrines.

gloss.en: of the boundless ocean of transmigration
the people who have fallen in
the pickaxe that cuts through rival doctrines

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
देशिकपरमशिवेन्द्रादेशवशोद्बुद्धदिव्यमहिमाऽहम ।
स्वात्मनि विश्रान्तिकृते सरसं प्रस्तौमि किञ्चिदिदम ॥3॥
units.iast:
deśikaparamaśivendrādeśavaśodbuddhadivyamahimā'ham |
svātmani viśrāntikṛte sarasaṃ prastaumi kiñcididam ||3||
units.translation: Awakened to divine greatness by the command of the teacher Paramasivendra, I offer this small, gracious composition so that I may rest in my own Self.

gloss.en: by the command of the teacher Paramasivendra
for resting in my own Self

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
निरुपमनित्यनिरीहो निष्कलनिर्मायनिर्गुणाकारः ।
विगलितसर्वविकल्पः शुद्धो बुद्धश्चकास्ति परमात्मा ॥4॥
units.iast:
nirupamanityanirīho niṣkalanirmāyanirguṇākāraḥ |
vigalitasarvavikalpaḥ śuddho buddhaścakāsti paramātmā ||4||
units.translation: The supreme Self shines without a peer: eternal, desireless, partless, free from māyā and qualities, beyond every thought, pure and awake.
units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
स्वाविद्यैकनिबद्धः कुर्वन्कर्माणि मुह्यमानः सन ।
दैवाद्विधूतबन्धः स्वात्मज्ञानान्मुनिर्जयति ॥5॥
units.iast:
svāvidyaikanibaddhaḥ kurvankarmāṇi muhyamānaḥ san |
daivādvidhūtabandhaḥ svātmajñānānmunirjayati ||5||
units.translation: The sage, bound only by his own ignorance, performs actions while deluded; by good fortune his bondage is shaken off, and through knowledge of his own Self he prevails.

gloss.en: bound only by his own ignorance
through knowledge of his own Self

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 6
units.deva:
मायावशेन सुप्तो मध्ये पश्यन्सहस्रशः स्वप्नान ।
देशिकवचःप्रबुद्धो दीव्यत्यानन्दवारिधौ कोऽपि ॥6॥
units.iast:
māyāvaśena supto madhye paśyansahasraśaḥ svapnān |
deśikavacaḥprabuddho dīvyatyānandavāridhau ko'pi ||6||
units.translation: Someone, asleep under māyā and seeing thousands of dreams within, is awakened by the teacher's words and shines in the ocean of bliss.
units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 7
units.deva:
प्राकृतभावमपास्य स्वीकृतनिजरूपसच्चिदानन्दः ।
गुरुवरकरुणापाङ्गाद्गौरवमासाद्य माद्यति प्राज्ञः ॥7॥
units.iast:
prākṛtabhāvamapāsya svīkṛtanijarūpasaccidānandaḥ |
guruvarakaruṇāpāṅgādgauravamāsādya mādyati prājñaḥ ||7||
units.translation: Setting aside the ordinary state, the wise one takes up his own nature as being-consciousness-bliss; touched by the great teacher's compassionate glance, he rejoices in that dignity.

gloss.en: having taken up one's own nature
from the great teacher's compassionate glance

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 8
units.deva:
श्रीगुरुकृपया सच्चित्सुखनिजरूपे निमग्नधीर्मौनी ।
विहरति कश्चन विबुधः शान्ताहन्तो नितान्तमुदितान्तः ॥8॥
units.iast:
śrīgurukṛpayā saccitsukhanijarūpe nimagnadhīrmaunī |
viharati kaścana vibudhaḥ śāntāhanto nitāntamuditāntaḥ ||8||
units.translation: By the revered guru's grace, a silent sage with mind immersed in his own nature of being, consciousness, and bliss lives in deep peace, inwardly glad.

gloss.en: in one's own nature of being, consciousness, and bliss
with an inward heart wholly glad

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 9
units.deva:
गुरुवरकरुणालहरीव्यतिकरभरशीतलस्वान्तः ।
रमते यतिवर एको निरुपमसुखसीमनि स्वैरम ॥9॥
units.iast:
guruvarakaruṇālaharīvyatikarabharaśītalasvāntaḥ |
ramate yativara eko nirupamasukhasīmani svairam ||9||
units.translation: Cooled within by the full force of the great teacher's waves of compassion, the best ascetic freely delights on the shore of incomparable bliss.

gloss.en: the great teacher's waves of compassion
on the shore of incomparable bliss

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 10
units.deva:
श्रीदेशिकवरकरुणारविकरसमपोहितान्तरध्वान्तः ।
विहरन्मस्करिवर्यो निरवधिकानन्दनीरधावास्ते ॥10॥
units.iast:
śrīdeśikavarakaruṇāravikarasamapohitāntaradhvāntaḥ |
viharanmaskarivaryo niravadhikānandanīradhāvāste ||10||
units.translation: As he wanders, the foremost renunciant has his inner darkness swept away by the sunlike ray of the teacher's grace and abides in the boundless ocean of bliss.

gloss.en: cleared by the sunlike rays of the great teacher's compassion
in the boundless ocean of bliss

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 11
units.deva:
जनिविपरीतक्रमतो बुद्ध्या प्रविलाप्य पञ्चभूतानि ।
परिशिष्टमात्मतत्त्वं पश्यन्नास्ते मुनिः शान्तः ॥11॥
units.iast:
janiviparītakramato buddhyā pravilāpya pañcabhūtāni |
pariśiṣṭamātmatattvaṃ paśyannāste muniḥ śāntaḥ ||11||
units.translation: Through understanding, dissolving the five elements in reverse order, the tranquil sage sees what remains, the truth of the Self, and rests there.

gloss.en: in the reverse order of birth

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 12
units.deva:
जगदखिलमिदमसारं मायिकमेवेति मनसि मन्वानः ।
पर्यटति पाटिताशः प्रगलितमदमानमत्सरः कोऽपि ॥12॥
units.iast:
jagadakhilamidamasāraṃ māyikameveti manasi manvānaḥ |
paryaṭati pāṭitāśaḥ pragalitamadamānamatsaraḥ ko'pi ||12||
units.translation: Thinking that this entire world is insubstantial, merely māyā, someone wanders, casting off desire, pride, conceit, and envy.

gloss.en: with pride, conceit, and envy dissolved

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 13
units.deva:
नात्मनि किञ्चिन्माया तत्कार्यं वाऽस्ति वस्तुतो विमले ।
इति निश्चयवानन्तः हृष्यत्यानन्दनिर्भरो योगी ॥13॥
units.iast:
nātmani kiñcinmāyā tatkāryaṃ vā'sti vastuto vimale |
iti niścayavānantaḥ hṛṣyatyānandanirbharo yogī ||13||
units.translation: The yogin is certain within: in the stainless Self there is in truth nothing of māyā or its effects. Filled with bliss, he rejoices.

gloss.en: there is nothing in the Self
in truth, in the stainless one

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 14
units.deva:
त्वमहमभिमानहीनो मोदितनानाजनाचारः ।
विहरति बालवदेको विमलसुखाम्भोनिधौ मग्नः ॥14॥
units.iast:
tvamahamabhimānahīno moditanānājanācāraḥ |
viharati bālavadeko vimalasukhāmbhonidhau magnaḥ ||14||
units.translation: Free from the notions you and I, taking delight in the varied ways of people, one solitary sage wanders like a child, immersed in the clear ocean of bliss.

gloss.en: free from the notions you and I
delighting in the varied ways of people
in the clear ocean of bliss

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 15
units.deva:
अवधूतकर्मजालो जडबधिरान्धोपमः कोऽपि ।
आत्मारामो यतिराडटवीकोणेष्वटन्नास्ते ॥15॥
units.iast:
avadhūtakarmajālo jaḍabadhirāndhopamaḥ ko'pi |
ātmārāmo yatirāḍaṭavīkoṇeṣvaṭannāste ||15||
units.translation: Having shaken off the net of action, someone dwells in the recesses of the forest like a mute, deaf, or blind person, delighting in the Self.

gloss.en: having shaken off the net of action
like a dull, deaf, or blind person

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 16
units.deva:
शान्त्या दृढोपगूढः शान्तसमस्तान्यवेदनोदारः ।
रमते रसज्ञ एको रम्ये स्वानन्दपर्यङ्के ॥16॥
units.iast:
śāntyā dṛḍhopagūḍhaḥ śāntasamastānyavedanodāraḥ |
ramate rasajña eko ramye svānandaparyaṅke ||16||
units.translation: Firmly embraced by peace, noble and no longer troubled by awareness of anything else, a connoisseur of bliss alone rests on the lovely couch of his own joy.

gloss.en: free from awareness of all else
on the lovely couch of his own joy

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 17
units.deva:
उन्मूलितविषयारिः स्वीकृतवैराग्यसर्वस्वः ।
स्वात्मानन्दमहिम्नि स्वाराज्येऽस्मिन विराजते यतिराट ॥17॥
units.iast:
unmūlitaviṣayāriḥ svīkṛtavairāgyasarvasvaḥ |
svātmānandamahimni svārājye'smin virājate yatirāṭ ||17||
units.translation: The king of ascetics, having uprooted the enemy of sense objects and claimed the full treasure of dispassion, shines in the sovereignty of his own Self-bliss.

gloss.en: having uprooted the enemy of sense objects
having claimed the full treasure of dispassion
in the sovereignty of his own Self-bliss

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 18
units.deva:
सवितर्यपि शीतरुचौ चन्द्रे तीक्ष्णेऽप्यधो वहत्यग्नौ ।
मायिकमिदमिति जानन्जीवन्मुक्तो न विस्मयी भवति ॥18॥
units.iast:
savitaryapi śītarucau candre tīkṣṇe'pyadho vahatyagnau |
māyikamidamiti jānanjīvanmukto na vismayī bhavati ||18||
units.translation: Even if the sun grew cool like the moon, the moon burned fiercely, or fire flowed downward, one liberated while living would not be surprised, knowing it to be māyā.

gloss.en: even if the moon were fierce

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 19
units.deva:
अज्ञानवैरिविजयी प्रज्ञामातङ्गमस्तकारूढः ।
विहरति संयमिराजः समरससुखधाम्नि सर्वतो रम्ये ॥19॥
units.iast:
ajñānavairivijayī prajñāmātaṅgamastakārūḍhaḥ |
viharati saṃyamirājaḥ samarasasukhadhāmni sarvato ramye ||19||
units.translation: Victorious over the enemy of ignorance, riding atop the elephant of insight, the king of self-restraint wanders in the delightful abode of undivided bliss.

gloss.en: riding atop the elephant of insight
in the abode of undivided bliss

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 20
units.deva:
शान्ताहंकृतिदोषः सुसमाहितमानसः कोऽपि ।
पूर्णेन्दुशिशिरभावो राजत्यानन्दसत्यचिद्रसिकः ॥20॥
units.iast:
śāntāhaṃkṛtidoṣaḥ susamāhitamānasaḥ ko'pi |
pūrṇenduśiśirabhāvo rājatyānandasatyacidrasikaḥ ||20||
units.translation: Someone who has quieted the fault of ego and gathered the mind shines cool as the full moon, savoring the nectar of bliss, reality, and consciousness.

gloss.en: whose fault of ego is quieted
cool in nature like the full moon

units.sectionTitle: Invocation and verses 1–20 · The teacher’s grace and the ascetic’s bliss

units.label: Verse 21
units.deva:
तिष्ठन्परत्र धाम्नि स्वीयसुखास्वादपरवशः कश्चित ।
क्वापि ध्यायति कुहचिद्गायति कुत्रापि नृत्यति स्वैरम ॥21॥
units.iast:
tiṣṭhanparatra dhāmni svīyasukhāsvādaparavaśaḥ kaścit |
kvāpi dhyāyati kuhacidgāyati kutrāpi nṛtyati svairam ||21||
units.translation: Absorbed in tasting his own happiness, someone established in the supreme abode meditates in one place, sings in another, and dances elsewhere, freely.

gloss.en: absorbed in tasting his own happiness

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 22
units.deva:
अगृहीताघकलङ्कः प्रशमितसङ्कल्पविभ्रमः प्राज्ञः ।
न्यक्कृतकार्यकलापस्तिष्ठत्यापूर्णसीमनि क्वापि ॥22॥
units.iast:
agṛhītāghakalaṅkaḥ praśamitasaṅkalpavibhramaḥ prājñaḥ |
nyakkṛtakāryakalāpastiṣṭhatyāpūrṇasīmani kvāpi ||22||
units.translation: The wise one is unstained by sin and has stilled the turmoil of thought; having dismissed all activity, he abides somewhere in the boundless expanse.

gloss.en: with the turmoil of thought stilled

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 23
units.deva:
चपलं मनकुरङ्गं चारु गृहीत्वा विमर्शवागुरया ।
निगमारण्यविहारश्रान्तः शेते स्वधाम्नि कोऽप्येकः ॥23॥
units.iast:
capalaṃ manakuraṅgaṃ cāru gṛhītvā vimarśavāgurayā |
nigamāraṇyavihāraśrāntaḥ śete svadhāmni ko'pyekaḥ ||23||
units.translation: Having skillfully caught the restless deer of the mind in the net of inquiry, one sage, tired from roaming the forest of the Vedas, rests in his own abode.

gloss.en: the restless deer of the mind
with the fine net of inquiry
tired from roaming the forest of the Vedas

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 24
units.deva:
दारुणचित्तव्याघ्रं धीरमनःखड्गधारया हत्वा ।
अभयारण्ये कोऽपि स्वैरविहारी जयत्येकः ॥24॥
units.iast:
dāruṇacittavyāghraṃ dhīramanaḥkhaḍgadhārayā hatvā |
abhayāraṇye ko'pi svairavihārī jayatyekaḥ ||24||
units.translation: Having slain the fierce tiger of the mind with the blade of steady discernment, one victor wanders at ease in the fearless forest.

gloss.en: the fierce tiger of the mind
with the blade of steady discernment

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 25
units.deva:
सज्जनहृदयसरोजोन्मीलनकरधीकरप्रसरः ।
एको यतिवरपूषा निर्दोषश्चरति चिद्गगने ॥25॥
units.iast:
sajjanahṛdayasarojonmīlanakaradhīkaraprasaraḥ |
eko yativarapūṣā nirdoṣaścarati cidgagane ||25||
units.translation: A sun among the best ascetics, whose rays of wisdom open the lotuses in good people's hearts, blamelessly traverses the sky of consciousness.

gloss.en: whose rays open the lotus-hearts of good people
one sun among the best ascetics

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 26
units.deva:
कुवलयविकासकारणमज्ञानध्वान्तकौमुदीप्रज्ञः ।
शुद्धो मुनीन्द्रचन्द्रः सुरसेव्ये लसति विष्णुपदे ॥26॥
units.iast:
kuvalayavikāsakāraṇamajñānadhvāntakaumudīprajñaḥ |
śuddho munīndracandraḥ surasevye lasati viṣṇupade ||26||
units.translation: A moon among sages, whose wisdom makes the lilies bloom and dispels the dark of ignorance, shines in Viṣṇu's station, revered by the gods.

gloss.en: whose wisdom is moonlight dispelling ignorance
in the place worshipped by gods

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 27
units.deva:
स्वानन्दामृतसेकैरान्तरसंतापसंततिं शमयन ।
चित्रमचञ्चलवृत्तिश्चिद्व्योमनि भाति योगिवर्यघनः ॥27॥
units.iast:
svānandāmṛtasekairāntarasaṃtāpasaṃtatiṃ śamayan |
citramacañcalavṛttiścidvyomani bhāti yogivaryaghanaḥ ||27||
units.translation: A marvel: the cloud of the finest yogis, with an unwavering mind, cools the inner heat with showers of the nectar of its own bliss and shines in the sky of consciousness.

gloss.en: with showers of the nectar of one's own bliss
the cloud among the finest yogis

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 28
units.deva:
सुमनःसौरभमञ्जुलसञ्चारनिवारिताखिलश्रान्तिः ।
संयमिचारुसमीरो विहरत्यानन्दसंविदारामे ॥28॥
units.iast:
sumanaḥsaurabhamañjulasañcāranivāritākhilaśrāntiḥ |
saṃyamicārusamīro viharatyānandasaṃvidārāme ||28||
units.translation: A beautiful breeze among the self-restrained, whose sweet movement removes every weariness, wanders in the garden of blissful awareness.

gloss.en: a beautiful breeze among the self-restrained
in the garden of blissful awareness

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 29
units.deva:
निःश्रेयससरसफले निर्मलविज्ञानपल्लवमनोज्ञे ।
वीतभये विपिनतले यतिशितिकण्ठो विभाति कोऽप्येकः ॥29॥
units.iast:
niḥśreyasasarasaphale nirmalavijñānapallavamanojñe |
vītabhaye vipinatale yatiśitikaṇṭho vibhāti ko'pyekaḥ ||29||
units.translation: A blue-throated ascetic, alone and free of fear, shines in a forest glade lovely with the fruit of highest good and shoots of stainless wisdom.

gloss.en: lovely with the fruit of highest good
charming with shoots of stainless knowledge

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 30
units.deva:
निःसारभुवनमरुतलमुत्सार्यानन्दसाररसपूर्णे ।
वरसरसि चिन्मयेऽस्मिन्परहंसः कोऽपि दीव्यति स्वैरम ॥30॥
units.iast:
niḥsārabhuvanamarutalamutsāryānandasārarasapūrṇe |
varasarasi cinmaye'sminparahaṃsaḥ ko'pi dīvyati svairam ||30||
units.translation: A certain supreme swan freely sports in this fine, conscious lake, full to the brim with the essence of bliss, after sweeping away the world's barren desert.

gloss.en: full of the essence and sap of bliss

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 31
units.deva:
निखिलागमपल्लविते निगमशिरस्तन्त्रशीतलोद्याने ।
मधुरतरमञ्जुवाचः कूजन्नास्ते यतीद्रकलकण्ठः ॥31॥
units.iast:
nikhilāgamapallavite nigamaśirastantraśītalodyāne |
madhurataramañjuvācaḥ kūjannāste yatīdrakalakaṇṭhaḥ ||31||
units.translation: A cuckoo among ascetics, with a sweet and charming voice, sits in the cool garden of the Veda, whose branches are all the scriptures.

gloss.en: whose branches are all the scriptures
in the cool garden of the Veda's crown and sacred teaching

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 32
units.deva:
दारितमोहमदेभो दूरीकृतसकलदुरितशार्दूलः ।
विबुधोत्तमसिंहवरो विहरत्यानन्दविततकान्तारे ॥32॥
units.iast:
dāritamohamadebho dūrīkṛtasakaladuritaśārdūlaḥ |
vibudhottamasiṃhavaro viharatyānandavitatakāntāre ||32||
units.translation: A lion among the best of the wise, having torn apart the elephant of delusion and driven away every tiger of evil, roams the vast forest of bliss.

gloss.en: having torn apart the elephant of delusion
having driven off every tiger of evil
the lion among the best of the wise
in the broad forest of bliss

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 33
units.deva:
अज्ञानमृगवरोज्झितविज्ञानोत्तुङ्गशृङ्गशिखरितले ।
मतिसलिलशीतलाङ्गो यतिमदकलभो विराजते विहरन ॥33॥
units.iast:
ajñānamṛgavarojjhitavijñānottuṅgaśṛṅgaśikharitale |
matisalilaśītalāṅgo yatimadakalabho virājate viharan ||33||
units.translation: A young elephant among ascetics, its body cooled by the waters of discernment, wanders and shines upon the lofty peak of knowledge, far from the deer of ignorance.

gloss.en: far from the deer of ignorance
on the lofty peak of knowledge
with body cooled by the waters of discernment

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 34
units.deva:
नासाञ्चलनिहिताक्षो नामादिभ्यो निवर्तितस्वान्तः ।
तटिनीतटेषु तत्त्वं ध्यायन्नास्ते यतिः कोऽपि ॥34॥
units.iast:
nāsāñcalanihitākṣo nāmādibhyo nivartitasvāntaḥ |
taṭinītaṭeṣu tattvaṃ dhyāyannāste yatiḥ ko'pi ||34||
units.translation: With gaze set on the tip of his nose and mind turned back from names and the rest, some ascetic sits on the riverbank contemplating truth.

gloss.en: with gaze set on the tip of the nose
with mind withdrawn from names and the rest

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 35
units.deva:
आशावसनो मौनी नैराश्यालङ्कृतः शान्तः ।
करतलभिक्षापात्रस्तरुतलनिलयो मुनिर्जयति ॥35॥
units.iast:
āśāvasano maunī nairāśyālaṅkṛtaḥ śāntaḥ |
karatalabhikṣāpātrastarutalanilayo munirjayati ||35||
units.translation: Clad in the directions, silent, peaceful, and adorned with freedom from expectation, a sage triumphs with a begging bowl in his palm, living beneath a tree.

gloss.en: with the palm of the hand as begging bowl

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 36
units.deva:
विजननदीकुञ्जगृहे मञ्जुलपुलिनैकमञ्जुतरतल्पे ।
शेते कोऽपि यतीन्द्रः समरससुखबोधवस्तुनिस्तन्द्रः ॥36॥
units.iast:
vijananadīkuñjagṛhe mañjulapulinaikamañjutaratalpe |
śete ko'pi yatīndraḥ samarasasukhabodhavastunistandraḥ ||36||
units.translation: In a secluded house in a river grove, on a most lovely bed of sand, a great ascetic lies awake in the reality of undivided bliss and awareness.

gloss.en: in a secluded house in a river grove
on an exceedingly lovely bed of sand
in the reality of undivided bliss and awareness

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 37
units.deva:
भूतलमृदुतरशय्यः शीतलवातैकचामरः शान्तः ।
राकाहिमकरदीपो राजति यतिराजशेखरः कोऽपि ॥37॥
units.iast:
bhūtalamṛdutaraśayyaḥ śītalavātaikacāmaraḥ śāntaḥ |
rākāhimakaradīpo rājati yatirājaśekharaḥ ko'pi ||37||
units.translation: With the earth for a soft bed and cool wind for a fan, the crest-jewel of kings of ascetics shines like the full-moon lamp.

gloss.en: with the earth as a soft bed
with cool wind as a fan
the crest-jewel of kings of ascetics

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 38
units.deva:
विपुलशिलातलफलके विमलसरिद्वारिपरिवृतोदारे ।
मन्दं मलयजपवने वाति प्रस्वपिति कोऽपि यतिराजः ॥38॥
units.iast:
vipulaśilātalaphalake vimalasaridvāriparivṛtodāre |
mandaṃ malayajapavane vāti prasvapiti ko'pi yatirājaḥ ||38||
units.translation: On a broad, smooth stone slab, surrounded by the pure waters of a generous river, some king of ascetics breathes gently and sleeps in the sandal-scented breeze.

gloss.en: surrounded by the pure waters of a generous river

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 39
units.deva:
आन्तरमेकं किञ्चित्सन्ततमनुसन्दधन्महामौनी ।
करपुटभिक्षामश्नन्नटति हि वीथ्यां जडाकृतिः कोऽपि ॥39॥
units.iast:
āntaramekaṃ kiñcitsantatamanusandadhanmahāmaunī |
karapuṭabhikṣāmaśnannaṭati hi vīthyāṃ jaḍākṛtiḥ ko'pi ||39||
units.translation: A great silent sage, continually attending to the one inner reality, wanders through the street eating alms from cupped hands, appearing like a dullard.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 40
units.deva:
प्रविलाप्य जगदशेषं परिशिष्टाखण्डवस्तुपरतन्त्रः ।
प्राश्नाति कवलमास्ये प्राप्तं प्रारब्धकर्मणा कोऽपि ॥40॥
units.iast:
pravilāpya jagadaśeṣaṃ pariśiṣṭākhaṇḍavastuparatantraḥ |
prāśnāti kavalamāsye prāptaṃ prārabdhakarmaṇā ko'pi ||40||
units.translation: Having dissolved the whole world and relying on what remains, the indivisible reality, someone eats whatever morsel comes to his mouth through prārabdha karma.

gloss.en: relying on the indivisible reality that remains

units.sectionTitle: Verses 21–40 · The realized renunciant’s life and freedom

units.label: Verse 41
units.deva:
निन्दति किमपि न योगी नन्दति नैवापरं किमप्यन्तः ।
चन्दनशीतलहृदयः कन्दलितानन्दमन्थरः स्वास्ते ॥41॥
units.iast:
nindati kimapi na yogī nandati naivāparaṃ kimapyantaḥ |
candanaśītalahṛdayaḥ kandalitānandamantharaḥ svāste ||41||
units.translation: The yogin does not censure anything, nor inwardly rejoice over anything else; with a heart cool as sandalwood, he rests, languid with blossoming bliss.

gloss.en: with a heart cool as sandalwood

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 42
units.deva:
सन्त्यज्य शास्त्रजालं संव्यवहारं च सर्वतस्त्यक्त्वा ।
आश्रित्य पूर्णपदवीमास्ते निष्कम्पदीपवद्योगी ॥42॥
units.iast:
santyajya śāstrajālaṃ saṃvyavahāraṃ ca sarvatastyaktvā |
āśritya pūrṇapadavīmāste niṣkampadīpavadyogī ||42||
units.translation: Leaving aside the web of scriptures and abandoning worldly dealings in every respect, the yogin rests like an unwavering lamp, relying on the state of fullness.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 43
units.deva:
तृणपङ्कचर्चिताङ्गस्तृणमिव विश्वं विलोकयन्योगी ।
विहरति रहसि वनान्ते विजरामरभूम्नि विश्रान्तः ॥43॥
units.iast:
tṛṇapaṅkacarcitāṅgastṛṇamiva viśvaṃ vilokayanyogī |
viharati rahasi vanānte vijarāmarabhūmni viśrāntaḥ ||43||
units.translation: His body smeared with grass and mud, seeing the world as a blade of grass, the yogin rests in the timeless, deathless ground, wandering alone at the forest's end.

gloss.en: with body smeared by grass and mud

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 44
units.deva:
पश्यति किमपि न रूपं न वदति न शृणोति किञ्चिदपि वचनम ।
तिष्ठति निरुपमभूमनि निष्ठामवलम्ब्य काष्ठवद्योगी ॥44॥
units.iast:
paśyati kimapi na rūpaṃ na vadati na śṛṇoti kiñcidapi vacanam |
tiṣṭhati nirupamabhūmani niṣṭhāmavalambya kāṣṭhavadyogī ||44||
units.translation: Seeing no particular form, speaking no word, hearing nothing, the yogin stands as still as a log, established in the incomparable ground.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 45
units.deva:
जात्यभिमानविहीनो जन्तुषु सर्वत्र पूर्णतां पश्यन ।
गूढं चरति यतीन्द्रो मूढवदखिलागमार्थतत्त्वज्ञः ॥45॥
units.iast:
jātyabhimānavihīno jantuṣu sarvatra pūrṇatāṃ paśyan |
gūḍhaṃ carati yatīndro mūḍhavadakhilāgamārthatattvajñaḥ ||45||
units.translation: Free from pride of birth and seeing fullness everywhere among living beings, the lord of ascetics, knower of the truth and meaning of all scripture, moves secretly like a fool.

gloss.en: knower of the truth and meaning of all scripture

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 46
units.deva:
उपधाय बाहुमूलं परिधायाकाशमवनिमास्तीर्य ।
प्रस्वपिति विरतिवनितां परिरभ्यानन्दपरवशः कोऽपि ॥46॥
units.iast:
upadhāya bāhumūlaṃ paridhāyākāśamavanimāstīrya |
prasvapiti virativanitāṃ parirabhyānandaparavaśaḥ ko'pi ||46||
units.translation: Using his arm as a pillow and the sky as his covering, spreading the earth beneath him, someone sleeps, bliss-intoxicated, embracing the bride of renunciation.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 47
units.deva:
गतभेदवासनाभिः स्वप्रज्ञोदारवारनारीभिः ।
रमते सह यतिराजस्त्रय्यन्तान्तःपुरे कोऽपि ॥47॥
units.iast:
gatabhedavāsanābhiḥ svaprajñodāravāranārībhiḥ |
ramate saha yatirājastrayyantāntaḥpure ko'pi ||47||
units.translation: In the inner palace of the Upaniṣads, the king of ascetics delights with women of expansive wisdom, whose noble insights have lost every trace of difference.

gloss.en: whose tendencies toward difference have gone
with noble women that are one's own expansive wisdom
in the inner palace of the Upaniṣads

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 48
units.deva:
वैराग्यविपुलमार्गं विज्ञानोद्दामदीपिकोद्दीप्तम ।
आरुह्य तत्त्वहर्म्यं मुक्त्या सह मोदते यतिराट ॥48॥
units.iast:
vairāgyavipulamārgaṃ vijñānoddāmadīpikoddīptam |
āruhya tattvaharmyaṃ muktyā saha modate yatirāṭ ||48||
units.translation: Ascending the mansion of truth along the broad path of dispassion, lit by the blazing lamp of knowledge, the king of ascetics rejoices with liberation.

gloss.en: lit by the blazing lamp of knowledge

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 49
units.deva:
विजनतलोत्पलमालां वनितावैतृष्ण्यकल्पवल्लीं च ।
अपमानामृतगुटिकामात्मज्ञः कोऽपि गृह्णाति ॥49॥
units.iast:
vijanatalotpalamālāṃ vanitāvaitṛṣṇyakalpavallīṃ ca |
apamānāmṛtaguṭikāmātmajñaḥ ko'pi gṛhṇāti ||49||
units.translation: A knower of the Self takes up a garland of solitary lotuses, a wish-fulfilling vine of freedom from craving, and the nectar-pill of insult.

gloss.en: a wish-fulfilling vine of freedom from craving

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 50
units.deva:
न निषेधति दोषधिया गुणबुद्ध्या वा न किञ्चिदादत्ते ।
आविद्यकमखिलमिति ज्ञात्वोदास्ते मुनिः कोऽपि ॥50॥
units.iast:
na niṣedhati doṣadhiyā guṇabuddhyā vā na kiñcidādatte |
āvidyakamakhilamiti jñātvodāste muniḥ ko'pi ||50||
units.translation: Knowing that everything is born of ignorance, some sage neither rejects anything as flawed nor grasps anything as virtuous; he simply remains at ease.

gloss.en: knowing all this is born of ignorance

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 51
units.deva:
भूतं किमपि न मनुते भावि च किञ्चिन्न चिन्तयत्यन्तः ।
पश्यति न पुरोवर्त्यपि वस्तु समस्तार्थसमरसः कोऽपि ॥51॥
units.iast:
bhūtaṃ kimapi na manute bhāvi ca kiñcinna cintayatyantaḥ |
paśyati na purovartyapi vastu samastārthasamarasaḥ ko'pi ||51||
units.translation: A certain one, at one with the taste of all things, holds nothing as past and thinks of nothing as future; he does not even see the object directly before him.

gloss.en: at one with the taste of all things

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 52
units.deva:
निगृहीताखिलकरणो निर्मृष्टाशेषविषयेहः ।
तृप्तिमनुत्तमसीमां प्राप्तः पर्यटति कोऽपि यतिवर्यः ॥52॥
units.iast:
nigṛhītākhilakaraṇo nirmṛṣṭāśeṣaviṣayehaḥ |
tṛptimanuttamasīmāṃ prāptaḥ paryaṭati ko'pi yativaryaḥ ||52||
units.translation: Mastering all the senses and wiping out every desire for objects, a supreme ascetic has reached the highest limit of contentment and wanders.

gloss.en: having wiped out every desire for objects

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 53
units.deva:
सन्त्यजति नोपपन्नं नासम्पन्नं च वाञ्छति क्वापि ।
स्वस्थः शेते यतिराडान्तरमानन्दमनुभवन्नेकः ॥53॥
units.iast:
santyajati nopapannaṃ nāsampannaṃ ca vāñchati kvāpi |
svasthaḥ śete yatirāḍāntaramānandamanubhavannekaḥ ||53||
units.translation: The king of ascetics, at peace within, neither discards what has come nor longs for what has not; he lies alone, experiencing inward bliss.

gloss.en: does not discard what has come
and does not long for what has not come

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 54
units.deva:
कामपि विमलां पदवीमासाद्यानन्दसंविदुन्निद्राम ।
आस्ते भिक्षुक एको विहरन्निर्मुक्तबन्धनः स्वैरम ॥54॥
units.iast:
kāmapi vimalāṃ padavīmāsādyānandasaṃvidunnidrām |
āste bhikṣuka eko viharannirmuktabandhanaḥ svairam ||54||
units.translation: Attaining a pure state, a single beggar remains freely, unbound, awake in blissful awareness.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 55
units.deva:
वस्तुन्यस्तमिताखिलविश्वविहारे विलीनमनाः ।
राजति परानपेक्षो राजाऽखिलवीतरागाणाम ॥55॥
units.iast:
vastunyastamitākhilaviśvavihāre vilīnamanāḥ |
rājati parānapekṣo rājā'khilavītarāgāṇām ||55||
units.translation: The mind dissolved in reality, where all the worlds' activity has set, the king of the desireless shines, needing nothing.

gloss.en: where all the worlds' activity has set

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 56
units.deva:
आचार्यापाङ्गदृशा समवाप्तापारसंविदाकारः ।
प्रशमितसकलविभेदः परहंसः कश्चिदाभाति ॥56॥
units.iast:
ācāryāpāṅgadṛśā samavāptāpārasaṃvidākāraḥ |
praśamitasakalavibhedaḥ parahaṃsaḥ kaścidābhāti ||56||
units.translation: By the teacher's sidelong glance one supreme swan has gained the form of boundless awareness, stilled every distinction, and shines.

gloss.en: having gained the form of boundless awareness

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 57
units.deva:
वर्णाश्रमव्यवस्थामुत्तीर्य विधूय विद्यादीन ।
परिशिष्यते यतीन्द्रः परिपूर्णानन्दबोधमात्रेण ॥57॥
units.iast:
varṇāśramavyavasthāmuttīrya vidhūya vidyādīn |
pariśiṣyate yatīndraḥ paripūrṇānandabodhamātreṇa ||57||
units.translation: Rising above the order of caste and life-stages, and leaving behind even learning, the lord of ascetics remains as nothing but complete bliss and awareness.

gloss.en: the order of caste and life-stages
shaking off even learning and the rest
as nothing but complete bliss and awareness

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 58
units.deva:
क्षयमुपनीय समस्तं कर्म प्रारब्धमुपभुज्य ।
प्रविगलितदेहबन्धः प्राज्ञो ब्रह्मैव केवलं भवति ॥58॥
units.iast:
kṣayamupanīya samastaṃ karma prārabdhamupabhujya |
pravigalitadehabandhaḥ prājño brahmaiva kevalaṃ bhavati ||58||
units.translation: When all karma has been exhausted and the results of prārabdha have been lived through, the wise one, free from the body's bond, becomes Brahman alone.

gloss.en: having lived through what has begun to bear fruit

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 59
units.deva:
स्तिमितमनन्तमनाद्यं सन्ततमानन्दबोधघनम ।
अविकल्पमाद्यमेकं सन्मात्रं विद्यते किमपि ॥59॥
units.iast:
stimitamanantamanādyaṃ santatamānandabodhaghanam |
avikalpamādyamekaṃ sanmātraṃ vidyate kimapi ||59||
units.translation: Something beginningless, still, endless, continuous, dense with bliss and awareness, the primal, singular, concept-free reality exists as pure being.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 60
units.deva:
अक्षरमजरमजातं सूक्ष्मतरापूर्वशुद्धविज्ञानम ।
प्रगलितसर्वक्लेशं परतत्त्वं वर्तते किमपि ॥60॥
units.iast:
akṣaramajaramajātaṃ sūkṣmatarāpūrvaśuddhavijñānam |
pragalitasarvakleśaṃ paratattvaṃ vartate kimapi ||60||
units.translation: Something imperishable, ageless, unborn, subtler than the subtle, supremely pure awareness, free of every affliction: the highest reality abides.

gloss.en: pristine awareness subtler than the subtle

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 61
units.deva:
सुखतरममरमदूरं सारं संसारवारिधेस्तीरम ।
समरसमभयमपारं तत्किञ्चन विद्यते तत्त्वम ॥61॥
units.iast:
sukhataramamaramadūraṃ sāraṃ saṃsāravāridhestīram |
samarasamabhayamapāraṃ tatkiñcana vidyate tattvam ||61||
units.translation: That reality is supremely delightful, undecaying, near, the essence and shore of the ocean of worldly existence: equal, fearless, boundless.

gloss.en: shore of the ocean of worldly life

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 62
units.deva:
अरसमगन्धमरूपं विरजस्कमसत्त्वमतमस्कम ।
निरुपमनिर्भयतत्त्वं तत्किमपि द्योतते नित्यम ॥62॥
units.iast:
arasamagandhamarūpaṃ virajaskamasattvamatamaskam |
nirupamanirbhayatattvaṃ tatkimapi dyotate nityam ||62||
units.translation: Something without taste, scent, or form, free from rajas, sattva, and tamas, the incomparable, fearless reality, always shines.
units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 63
units.deva:
इति गुरुकरुणापाङ्गादार्याभिर्द्व्यधिकषष्टिसङ्ख्याभिः ।
निरवद्याभिरवोचं निगमशिरस्तन्त्रसारभूतार्थम ॥63॥
units.iast:
iti gurukaruṇāpāṅgādāryābhirdvyadhikaṣaṣṭisaṅkhyābhiḥ |
niravadyābhiravocaṃ nigamaśirastantrasārabhūtārtham ||63||
units.translation: Thus, by the compassionate glance of the teacher, in sixty-two flawless āryā verses I have spoken the essence of the Vedic crown, the core of the tantras.

gloss.en: the essence of the Vedic crown and heart of the tantras

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 64
units.deva:
गदितमिममात्मविद्याविलासमनुवासरं स्मरन्विबुधः ।
परिणतपरात्मविद्यः प्रपद्यते सपदि परमार्थम ॥64॥
units.iast:
gaditamimamātmavidyāvilāsamanuvāsaraṃ smaranvibudhaḥ |
pariṇataparātmavidyaḥ prapadyate sapadi paramārtham ||64||
units.translation: Whoever, wise and mature in knowledge of the supreme Self, remembers this teaching named Ātmavidyāvilāsa each day reaches the supreme reality at once.

gloss.en: mature in knowledge of the supreme Self

units.sectionTitle: Verses 41–65 · Detachment, Self-knowledge, and nondual bliss

units.label: Verse 65
units.deva:
परमशिवेन्द्रश्रीगुरुशिष्येणेत्थं सदाशिवेन्द्रेण ।
रचितेयमात्मविद्याविलासनाम्नी कृतिः पूर्णा ॥65॥
units.iast:
paramaśivendraśrīguruśiṣyeṇetthaṃ sadāśivendreṇa |
raciteyamātmavidyāvilāsanāmnī kṛtiḥ pūrṇā ||65||
units.translation: This work named Ātmavidyāvilāsa is thus complete, composed by Sadāśivendra, disciple of the revered guru Paramasivendra.

gloss.en: by the disciple of revered guru Paramasivendra
